story.fullStory:
Molly Hatchet's "Flirtin' With Disaster" reached #42 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Flirtin' with Disaster" is a song by American Southern rock band Molly Hatchet, released in 1979 by Epic Records.

Written by three members of the band, it is their most popular song and remained on the US Billboard Hot 100 for 10 weeks, peaking at number 42 in March 1980.

It was released on the band's second studio album, Flirtin' with Disaster and is the only single released from the album.

The song peaked at #42 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 10 weeks on the chart.
